meetDoctor.title: Meet Dr. Gaurav Sharma
meetDoctor.subtitle: Over two decades of dedicated surgical and clinical orthopaedic practice in Sikandra, Agra. Grounded in meticulous clinical examination, transparent decision-making, and joint preservation first.
meetDoctor.bioP1: Dr. Gaurav Sharma is an established consultant orthopaedic, trauma, and joint replacement surgeon practising in Sikandra, Agra. With more than 20 years of clinical and surgical experience, he earned his M.B.B.S. from S.N. Medical College, Agra and completed his M.S. (Orthopaedics) from M.L.B. Medical College, Jhansi.
meetDoctor.bioP2: His clinical practice centres on comprehensive physical examination, transparent clinical reasoning, and conservative joint preservation wherever viable. When surgical intervention becomes necessary—such as in advanced osteoarthritis, acute sports tears, or complex skeletal trauma—he performs tissue-preserving primary and revision joint replacements and arthroscopic procedures aimed at rapid early mobilisation.

philosophy.title: How We Structure Your Care
philosophy.subtitle: A disciplined, four-stage pathway ensuring every patient understands their diagnosis, non-surgical options, and recovery roadmap before any treatment begins.
philosophy.step1Desc: Every consultation begins with an unhurried, hands-on clinical examination and direct correlation of your physical X-ray or MRI films. We evaluate not just the image, but how your joint functions in daily life.
philosophy.step2Desc: We explain all available pathways with complete transparency: structured physiotherapy, lifestyle modifications, biological preservation, or surgical intervention. You are never rushed into an operative decision.
philosophy.step3Desc: Whether starting non-surgical joint preservation or planning tissue-sparing joint replacement, we outline clear timelines, realistic outcomes, and what to expect at each milestone.
philosophy.step4Desc: Care does not end with a prescription or a surgery. We provide structured follow-ups, progressive rehabilitation guidance, and ongoing support until your mobility and independence are restored.

patientJourney.title: A Transparent, Step-by-Step Care Pathway
patientJourney.subtitle: Clear, objective, evidence-based steps designed to restore your movement without rushing into surgery.
patientJourney.step1Desc: Dr. Gaurav Sharma conducts a meticulous physical assessment of joint mobility, alignment, tenderness, and gait before requesting or reviewing scans.
patientJourney.step2Desc: Digital weight-bearing X-rays or MRI scans are correlated with your actual symptoms—treating the patient, not just the scan image.
patientJourney.step3Desc: We prioritize non-surgical rehabilitation, targeted physiotherapy, and joint-protective lifestyle modifications. Surgery is advised only when necessary.
patientJourney.pledgeTitle: Surgery Is Always the Final Option, Never the First
patientJourney.pledgeDesc: More than 70% of joint complaints can be successfully managed without an operation through timely medical management, therapeutic exercises, and joint offloading protocols.
